{{Intro/Resonator|Sigrika}} She is a student in the Preparatory Program at [[Startorch Academy]] and a member of its Birding Fan Club as well as a {{Extra Effect|Solsworn|Solsworn|Individuals gifted in calendrical calculation and a degree of resonance with the Exostrider and Soliskin are permitted into the Solisylum. There, they serve the Heliodic Six as aides and the tribe as healers and teachers, all while being groomed as the Six's eventual successors.}} from the [[Roya Tribe]]. Although she shoulders the heavy responsibility of being a [[Heliodic Six]] Successor, she is an overwhelmingly kind and gentle woman dedicated to helping her classmates through their struggles.

==Trivia==
===Etymology===
* {{Lang|non=''Sigrdrífa''|lit=driver to victory}} is the name the Iceland epic poem ''[[wp:Sigrdrífumál|Sigrdrífumál]]'' associates with the valkyrie Brynhildr.
* Sigrika's name can be broken down into Old Norse ''sigr'' and ''ríka'' meaning "victorious ruler." Alternatively, -ka was used in related languages as a diminutive, and the name would mean "little victory."
